items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I love him man. He's nice. Professor Minetta. He's taught a lot of musicians around here. Yeah I like him. Nice fella.

ctx.x: Uh-uh. He was down here about four almost more like six years ago. I think he went through here when his sister died and was here a couple of days is all. But hardly anybody saw him that I've taught. Never did see him Bill. We interviewed him uh two years ago in California. Yeah. Professor Minetta was out there with him.
That's a good. I love him man. He's nice. Professor Minetta. He's taught a lot of musicians around here. Yeah I like him. Nice fella.

Now I never get a chance to hear the issues. Yeah, or he was around Chicago a lot. I heard him in late days only from 1940. I met him when I was in California in 1940. He was playing bass then. Started giving up trombone and he came back a couple years later on trombone.
